question: A timber-frame wall is to be insulated with the wood fibre panel tested in the packet's laboratory report, so that the insulation alone has a thermal resistance of 3 m²·K/W. The panel's conductivity is the one measured dry, at a mean temperature of 10 °C. What mass of oven-dry panel does one square metre of wall need?

facts.conductivity.wood_fibre.dry: the thermal conductivity of the wood fibre panel measured dry, at a mean temperature of 10 °C
facts.density.wood_fibre: the oven-dry density of the wood fibre panel's specimens

result.description: the mass of oven-dry wood fibre panel per square metre of wall: thermal resistance × conductivity × density
